generate_text_gemma: generate text from a Gemma model given an input prompt with random or greedy sampling
sample_greedy_gemma: sample text from a Gemma model using greedy sampling to pick the most likely next token
extract_attention_weights: extract layer-wise attention weights and QKV matrices from a Gemma model for visualization
get_next_token_logits: get the next token logits probability distribution from a Gemma model given input text
load_gemma_model: load a Gemma-1B or Gemma-4B model with tokenizer and parameters for text generation
